title: ArchiveSnapshots
description: Persistent archive.org fallback ledger (spec 038 FR-008, US5). Lives at <vault>/_pipeline/archive-snapshots.json. Fail-and-defer (Q2): vault_health --apply exits 0 even when snapshots are deferred. Accumulates across cycles.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the last vault_health --apply pass.

snapshots.description: Map of original URL -> snapshot record.

snapshot_url.description: web.archive.org snapshot URL; null until archived.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the snapshot was created; null until archived.

status.description: archived = snapshot exists; deferred = rate-limited/failed, retry next cycle (fail-and-defer, Q2); unarchivable = robots.txt/paywall/media — will not retry.

attempts.description: How many times archiving was attempted (for deferred backoff).
